plan: [This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction: winner pays the highest other bid. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy with independent private values. Bid your true value to maximize expected surplus: you win when opponents bid below $42 and pay their bid, giving nonnegative profit. Bidding higher risks overpayment; bidding lower reduces profitable wins.]

[This auction charges the highest other bid (second-price). In independent private-value second-price auctions, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy. My private value is $29, so I will bid 29. This maximizes expected surplus: I win when price <29 and pay that price, avoiding overpayment risk.]

[This is a second-price sealed-bid auction, so bidding my true private value is a weakly dominant strategy. My private value is $48, so I will bid 48.0 to maximize expected surplus (value minus price) when I win. Ties are random but truthful bidding still maximizes long-run expected profit given independent draws.]
